   - Age at death: 71
   - Cause of death: Heart attack

2. **William Howard Taft** (born in Cincinnati, Ohio; September 15, 1857)
   - Died: March 8, 1930
   - Age at death: 71
   - Cause of death: Heart disease (cardiovascular disease)

- **James A. Garfield** (Ohio): Died at age 49 from gunshot wounds/infection
- **William McKinley** (Ohio): Died at age 58 from gunshot wounds
- **Warren G. Harding** (Ohio): Died at age 57-58 from heart attack (under 60)
